message:
Could Rohin’s reported raw-child example—checking what actually happened before reporting progress—help you assess this revision?
What image does your latest sentence create when a girl, rather than the earlier bird, lands on Whiskers’s shoulder and has feathers?
Would closer thought settle what you intend there, or would a small writing attempt provide better evidence of its effect?
Given that difference, what thinking or doing step do you choose to complete next?
What observation in the writing would make you change that choice?
What finding, uncertainty, and unfinished next step will you carry into the following turn?
